description: Ranks providers in a category by estimated monthly cost at the user's own numbers (card volume, average sale, employees, users, and so on), for the US, the UK or Australia. Returns links to the comparison table and provider pages, and quote links where quotes are available. Examples: EFTPOS and card machine fees, cheapest payroll software, POS system costs, inventory software pricing.

category.description: A category slug from list_categories, e.g. "payment-providers".

inputs.description: Calculator values keyed by input slug (list_categories gives each category's inputs). Inputs not supplied use the calculator defaults and are listed in defaulted_inputs. Unknown keys are returned in ignored_inputs.

market.description: The user's country: US, UK or AU.

provider.description: A provider or brand the user named, as a lowercase slug (e.g. "cin7", "windcave"). Every matching product is returned in focus with its own quote link.

name: compare
title: Compare providers by cost
